name: Lore City: Alkahest
source:
When Logan Apollo, business partner to unlicensed alchemist Mello Kurosol, returns all wrong from a job far outside Lore City limits, Mello must brew deadly potions for the malicious entity possessing Logan's body before time runs out.

Engage your friend in conversation to unwind the mystery of his capture, and brew your way out of a dire hostage situation before your alchemy lab becomes your tomb.
translation:
无证炼金术士梅洛·库罗索尔的生意搭档洛根·阿波罗从洛尔城远郊的一桩委托归来时，整个人变得极其不对劲——原来一尊怀有恶意的邪祟占据了洛根的躯体。梅洛必须在时限耗尽之前，为这个怪物熬制致命的魔药。

与挚友展开对话，抽丝剥茧查明他遇袭被俘的真相；在你的炼金工坊沦为葬身之地前，靠着熬制魔药从这场危急的人质劫持危机中杀出一条生路吧。
